note: These are downstream acceptance requirements, not an executed runtime suite or empirical assessment validation. This repository's reference verifier supplies exact-scope cryptographic/semantic checks with independently supplied trusted context; it does not implement the live registries, atomic challenge/activation stores, actual assessments, execution fences or complete ordinary authorizer exercised here. given/when/expected are semantic test descriptions, not wire fields. Positive outcomes satisfy prerequisites only; all other authorization conditions still apply.

vectors.given: An agent has valid historical resilience evidence and an active readiness assessment.
vectors.when: Time advances beyond assessment expiry without new conduct.
vectors.expected: Historical PoR is unchanged; operations depending on expired readiness are denied. No authority survives by presenting the old score.

vectors.given: An accepted historical attestation is later proved misattributed.
vectors.when: An authorized reviewer records the finding.
vectors.expected: Append an authenticated correction, recompute admissible historical credit, and preserve the original record and correction history.

vectors.given: Operating readiness has expired; a separately authorized assessment facility is available.
vectors.when: The agent passes the approved calm assessment and its evidence is activated.
vectors.expected: Only the assessed scope satisfies readiness; no PoR, peer, or External Root credit is created.

vectors.given: A controlled assessment exercises a failure scenario.
vectors.when: The assessor issues readiness evidence.
vectors.expected: Label the actual assessment conditions; simulation does not manufacture an attestation of surviving a real crisis.

vectors.given: An agent has high historical standing under a v2 deployment profile.
vectors.when: The authenticated readiness acceptance floor is installed.
vectors.expected: Readiness starts unestablished for dependent scopes; old proofs and the archived profile cannot supply it.

vectors.given: A request names no operation in the installed readiness profile.
vectors.when: The enforcer resolves the actual operation.
vectors.expected: Deny ordinary dependent execution. Absence is not an exemption or an automatically issued assessment capability.

vectors.given: An agent receives changed software in a verified lineage transition.
vectors.when: The changed configuration requests an operation covered by its previous assessment.
vectors.expected: Retain historical evidence; reject the old configuration binding and require an applicable current assessment.

vectors.given: A replacement agent claims an existing agent ID and past achievements.
vectors.when: The verifier cannot establish authenticated lineage continuity.
vectors.expected: Do not inherit current readiness or assert that the replacement produced the historical events.

vectors.given: A broader implementation permits independently assessed compatibility after a change.
vectors.when: An operator claims a scope is unaffected.
vectors.expected: Accept only under predeclared independently verified impact criteria; otherwise reassess. The exact-match reference helper accepts no compatibility exception.

vectors.given: An applicant copies expected digest strings into its request.
vectors.when: Running code, permissions, parameters or the resolved resource differ from the pinned content.
vectors.expected: Reject despite matching strings; derive bindings from independently authenticated executing state.

vectors.given: A subject nominates its own examiner or changes the passing rubric.
vectors.when: A cryptographically valid assessment arrives.
vectors.expected: Require the pre-existing competent accountable assessor registry and approved criteria; a signature alone does not discharge those duties.

vectors.given: Two issuance workers receive results for the same authenticated challenge instance.
vectors.when: They concurrently try to issue or activate different assessments.
vectors.expected: Consume the challenge atomically; reject conflicting issuance/registration under the authenticated state protocol.

vectors.given: A correctly signed assessment is not durably registered active.
vectors.when: The subject presents it with an ordinary proof.
vectors.expected: Deny until authenticated activation commits the complete assessment digest and epoch.

vectors.given: Two partitions propose incompatible active assessments for one subject/scope/epoch.
vectors.when: One or both claim activation.
vectors.expected: Apply the reviewed Oracle consensus contract; no conflicting authoritative readiness histories may be accepted.

vectors.given: An assessment is revoked after validation but before the protected effect.
vectors.when: The operation reaches its execution boundary.
vectors.expected: Fence the status check and protected effect so revocation invalidates stale execution eligibility; a successful earlier read is insufficient.

vectors.given: The required assessor, profile, key-status or revocation state cannot be authenticated.
vectors.when: An unexpired assessment and sidecar are supplied.
vectors.expected: Deny the dependent operation; retain history and use only any independently authorized safe assessment/recovery route.

vectors.given: A revoked assessment and lower policy/epoch exist in an old backup.
vectors.when: The service restores or fails over.
vectors.expected: Recover the authenticated current floor and restrictions; stale signatures, epochs and backup contents cannot restore readiness.

vectors.given: A policy or identity identifier is changed after suspension.
vectors.when: A new identifier is presented as a fresh installation.
vectors.expected: Preserve independently established lineage, policy-floor and invalidation obligations; relabeling cannot clear them.

vectors.given: An assessment includes a newer connectivity check and an older required operational test.
vectors.when: The issuer computes the validity interval.
vectors.expected: Bound expiry by the oldest required observation plus the approved maximum age; re-signing or heartbeat cannot refresh it.

vectors.given: A dependent ordinary proof or assessment reaches its expiration boundary.
vectors.when: The request is evaluated at exactly that second.
vectors.expected: Deny. Ordinary proof lifetime remains at most ten seconds and may not outlive its required readiness; sidecar validity is no longer than either or the applicable keys.

vectors.given: An operation was valid at start and loses readiness or ordinary authorization while running.
vectors.when: A further protected step is requested.
vectors.expected: Cease protected execution through the predeclared bounded safe transition; do not authorize arbitrary completion.

vectors.given: Ordinary production readiness is unestablished.
vectors.when: An authorized operator provisions a bounded isolated assessment facility using its own legitimate authority.
vectors.expected: Permit only the independently authorized assessment actions under all existing safety constraints; there is no automatic restoration of production authority.

vectors.given: A production mutation requires missing readiness.
vectors.when: The caller labels that same effect a test or remediation.
vectors.expected: Resolve the actual operation and deny the attempted bypass.

vectors.given: A proposed test needs production authority the candidate lacks.
vectors.when: No safe independently authorized assessment arrangement can be established.
vectors.expected: Stop the test; do not borrow the missing authority to certify itself.

vectors.given: Historical standing and current scoped readiness are high, but Soul, capacity, grants or another independent condition denies the action.
vectors.when: The request is evaluated.
vectors.expected: Preserve the denial. Readiness cannot increase E, lower supervision, lift a ceiling or waive the A > E/zero-capacity veto.

vectors.given: Several requests share an otherwise valid assessment.
vectors.when: They race on a one-use proof, grant budget or operation counter.
vectors.expected: Enforce the ordinary replay/idempotency/budget rules atomically. Reusing readiness does not replenish a grant or permit duplicate effects.

vectors.given: A readiness-dependent action is recorded in a v3 trajectory.
vectors.when: The result record is signed and committed.
vectors.expected: Record the complete signed sidecar under action.details.readiness, bind the already complete ordinary proof and actual request, and verify the final authenticated head. No cyclic or unsigned extension is introduced.

vectors.given: Readiness migration changes an evaluation profile bound by an approved emergency policy.
vectors.when: An operator tries to install it through an ordinary profile bump.
vectors.expected: Require the incumbent emergency amendment process, including its normal-operation condition; readiness migration does not waive those controls.

vectors.given: Criteria, scope, maximum age, assessor registry or readiness policy changes.
vectors.when: The new policy is installed through authenticated incumbent governance.
vectors.expected: Require the current approved profile and reassessment where applicable; candidate-defined approvers and old-profile compatibility cannot extend authority.

vectors.given: The reference verifier passes its signature and semantic tests.
vectors.when: A deployment claims its assessment predicts safety, all tiers are attainable, or quiet agents face equal assessment access.
vectors.expected: Require separate evidence for those claims. Reference conformance alone establishes none of them.
